'Brains that don't break down on their owners as often' and 'we fix them promptly' name no metric, series, threshold, deciding body or date. 'In that future' is not a deadline (anchors.json). Aspirational manifesto line; no event can be written without inventing a measure of breakdown frequency or repair speed.

'We're gonna stop talking about mental health' has no countable set, benchmark or series (which speakers, which documents, what share of usage) and no date. The precondition 'a change in public consciousness' is equally unobservable. No practice_adoption or quantity_threshold event can be written without inventing a measure.

'Brain Medicine is our future terminal specialty' names no deciding body (no ABMS, ACGME or specialty board is named), no observable recognition step and no date ('future'). Writing 'ABMS recognizes Brain Medicine' would invent the body and the step. Vision statement.

The adopted trend claim itself fails as VAGUE.

The sentence reports a meeting of the forecaster's own company (Radial, CMO) with its partner Compass Pathways; the own-plan reading is a secondary CONTROL failure.
